propositions: The reconciler unconditionally advances the cursor to the newest event time in each pass, dropping any candidate that failed to vote before the pass ended, even if retryable.
Gerrit webhooks plugin delivers at-most-once (not at-least-once), so dropped webhook events can only be recovered by the reconciler, which is currently broken.
A candidate whose review times out, encounters an error, or is deferred is silently dropped from all future reconciler windows because the cursor moves past it irrevocably.
Three observable states (bot down, review running, queued waiting, never queued/dropped) are indistinguishable to operators because queue_depth and held_back are not exposed.
The guarding unit test for reconciler retry passes with false green due to a fake events-log double that ignores the since parameter and returns the full event list regardless.

The fix clamps the cursor to a low-water mark: the minimum of the newest event or the oldest retryably-abandoned candidate, bounded by RECONCILE_MAX_HOLDBACK_SECONDS to prevent a poison-pill candidate from pinning the window forever.
